instructions: Before editing, identify the affected canonical owner, callers, tests, fixtures and exports.
Choose the first complete solution: use an existing canonical helper or command, then the platform or installed dependencies, then the smallest clear implementation.
Complete every required consumer change. Preserve source guards, validation, error handling, original bindings, historical receipts and effect fences.
Do not remove an adapter or generated projection without proving its owner and consumer equivalence.
Run the checks required for the exact changed source. Reuse adequate existing tests; add a focused test for a new failure mode.
Report a review finding only with a concrete affected case and source evidence. Match completion claims to observed checks.

rendering.format: Each instruction prefixed by "- ", joined with LF, with one final LF.
